title: 泰晤士河防洪閘
summary: 本課以泰晤士河防洪閘為入口，深入旋轉閘門力矩、河潮聯合作用與長期調適。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Thames Barrier as its entry point, this course examines rotating-gate torque, combined river and tidal effects, and long-term adaptation. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潮位2cosθ m、暴潮1cos(θ+60°) m，合成振幅√(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m，非兩峰直接相加3 m。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 另作固定姿態的敏感度比較：力臂維持1.5 m、淨重量與浮力矩−2 MN·m、摩擦矩0.5 MN·m，只把水壓合力4 MN改為5 MN。需求轉矩F×1.5−2+0.5由4.5增至6.0 MN·m，增加33.33%；這是獨立力擾動，不把它當作水位變動時力臂也固定的真實閘門預測。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m. Required torque is 4.5 MN·m for that static posture only. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume tide 2cosθ m and surge 1cos(θ+60°) m. Combined amplitude is √(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m, rather than the direct peak sum of 3 m. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. At the same posture, keep the lever arm at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment at −2 MN·m and friction moment at 0.5 MN·m, changing only water resultant from 4 MN to 5 MN. Required torque F×1.5−2+0.5 rises from 4.5 to 6.0 MN·m, or 33.33%. This isolated force perturbation does not predict a real stage change, which may also shift the lever arm.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「旋轉門體驅動力矩」與「暴潮相位與潮汐疊加」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rotating-gate drive torque" and "Surge phase and tidal superposition": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 旋轉門體驅動力矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rotating-gate drive torque: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「旋轉門體驅動力矩」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rotating-gate drive torque” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 旋轉閘門的驅動需求來自重量、浮力、水壓與摩擦的合成力矩。各力臂隨角度改變，最大水壓不一定對應最大驅動需求。 假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。 密封摩擦、沉積物與軸承偏心會讓負載峰值偏離理想曲線。若只以平均馬達功率檢查能力，短暫的起動高扭矩和局部拘束可能被完全掩蓋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「旋轉門體驅動力矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drive demand combines moments from weight, buoyancy, water pressure and friction. Lever arms vary with angle, so maximum water pressure need not coincide with maximum required drive torque. At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m. Required torque is 4.5 MN·m for that static posture only. Seal friction, sediment and bearing eccentricity shift peaks away from ideal curves. Average motor power can conceal brief breakaway torque demands and local restraint that govern actual motion capability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rotating-gate drive torque” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Maximum water pressure always coincides with maximum drive torque." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「旋轉門體驅動力矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rotating-gate drive torque”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「旋轉門體驅動力矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rotating-gate drive torque" is correct?
options: 最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。

兩個不同時刻的水位峰值相加就是實際聯合峰值。

steps.title: 旋轉門體驅動力矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rotating-gate drive torque: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「旋轉門體驅動力矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rotating-gate drive torque” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m. Required torque is 4.5 MN·m for that static posture only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿轉角建立分項力矩曲線，對照油壓、位置與轉速資料；分開啟動摩擦和持續轉動阻力，避免只用終點水位解釋整段動作。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build component moment curves against angle and compare pressure, position and speed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 旋轉門體驅動力矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rotating-gate drive torque: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「旋轉門體驅動力矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rotating-gate drive torque” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿轉角建立分項力矩曲線，對照油壓、位置與轉速資料；分開啟動摩擦和持續轉動阻力，避免只用終點水位解釋整段動作。比較起轉前後扭矩殘差，確認峰值是外載改變還是靜摩擦釋放造成的差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build component moment curves against angle and compare pressure, position and speed. Separate breakaway friction from running resistance instead of explaining an entire movement by the final water level. Compare torque residuals before and after breakaway to separate changed external load from the release of static friction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rotating-gate drive torque, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Build component moment curves against angle and compare pressure, position and speed. Separate breakaway friction from running resistance instead of explaining an entire movement by the final water level.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：密封摩擦、沉積物與軸承偏心會讓負載峰值偏離理想曲線。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Seal friction, sediment and bearing eccentricity shift peaks away from ideal curves. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 阻隔海潮時，上游河流仍持續入流，受保護河段因此變成暫時蓄水體。可用庫容取決於沿岸高程與支流，不能只看閘前水位。 假設關閉期間淨入流300 m³/s持續2 h、有效水面20 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m；忽略側向溢流與面積隨水位變化。 只防海側高水位而忽略河流洪峰，可能把洪水留在防線內側。以平坦水面替代長河段水力坡降，還會低估某些支流交會處的局部水位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「關閉期間河水蓄積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When sea levels are excluded, river inflow continues and the protected reach temporarily stores water. Available storage depends on bank elevations and tributaries, not only the level beside the barrier. Assume net inflow 300 m³/s for two hours over effective area 20 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m, excluding lateral spill and changes of area with stage. Excluding the sea while overlooking a river flood can retain water inside the defence. Replacing a long river gradient with a flat surface can underestimate levels near particular tributary junctions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “River storage during closure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 關於「關閉期間河水蓄積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 阻隔海潮時，上游河流仍持續入流，受保護河段因此變成暫時蓄水體。

optionsEn: When sea levels are excluded, river inflow continues and the protected reach temporarily stores water.
Upstream water level cannot keep rising after the sea is excluded.
Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue.

steps.title: 通航窗口與排程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Navigation windows and scheduling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通航窗口與排程」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Navigation windows and scheduling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 活動防洪結構同時是航運通道，通航窗口受水位、橋下空間與設備可用性約束。平均船舶到達率無法描述尖峰排隊與關閉後的復原時間。 假設停航3 h、到達率4 vessels/h，累積12 vessels；重開後處理6 vessels/h且仍到達4 vessels/h，清空需12/(6−4)=6 h。 若重開後服務率只等於到達率，既有隊列永遠無法消散。把通過閘區的時間與完整航段時間混用，則會錯算容量並掩蓋航道瓶頸。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通航窗口與排程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A movable flood defence is also a navigation route. Windows depend on level, clearance and availability; average vessel arrivals do not describe peak queues or recovery after a closure. Assume closure three hours with arrival rate four vessels per hour, accumulating twelve vessels. After reopening, service six and arrivals four per hour require 12/(6−4)=6 hours to clear. If reopened service merely matches arrivals, the existing queue never clears. Mixing barrier-crossing time with complete-route time miscalculates capacity and conceals bottlenecks elsewhere in the navigation channel. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Navigation windows and scheduling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設停航3 h、到達率4 vessels/h，累積12 vessels；重開後處理6 vessels/h且仍到達4 vessels/h，清空需12/(6−4)=6 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume closure three hours with arrival rate four vessels per hour, accumulating twelve vessels.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要航道重新開放，等待船舶隊列就會立即消失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 液壓功率與效率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic power and efficiency: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「液壓功率與效率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydraulic power and efficiency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測油壓、流量、溫度和門位速率，比較液壓輸入與機械輸出；確認量測位置是在泵側或缸側，避免把管路損失重複計入。將能量差換算成熱產生量並核對油溫趨勢，確認內漏推論符合能量守恆。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure pressure, flow, temperature and gate speed together, comparing hydraulic input with mechanical output. Identify pump-side versus cylinder-side measurements to avoid double-counting line losses. Convert the power difference into heat generation and compare temperature trends to test the leakage interpretation against energy conservation. Measure pressure, flow, temperature and gate speed together, comparing hydraulic input with mechanical output. Identify pump-side versus cylinder-side measurements to avoid double-counting line losses.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 液壓功率與效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic power and efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「液壓功率與效率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic power and efficiency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。只檢查電流或單點壓力，可能把效率惡化誤認為正常的負載變動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Internal leakage can preserve pressure while reducing useful cylinder flow, and heating changes viscosity. Current or pressure alone may make declining efficiency look like an ordinary change in external loading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「液壓功率與效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「防線接續高程」與「波浪脈衝與反力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Continuous defence elevations" and "Wave impulse and reaction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 防線接續高程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Continuous defence elevations: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「防線接續高程」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Continuous defence elevations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 防洪閘與兩岸堤牆必須形成連續高程線，局部低點會繞過強大的主結構。水位基準、沉降與門檻高程的差異往往比平均牆高更重要。 假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。 主閘設計再強也不能彌補遠端牆頂低點，局部沉降又可能持續發展。以地圖等高線代替接縫精密測量，會把繞流通道藏在資料解析度之下。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「防線接續高程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Barrier and bank defences must form a continuous elevation line. Local low points bypass strong main structures, making datum consistency, settlement and sill elevation more important than average wall height. Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m. Remaining geometric freeboard is 0.58 m, excluding wave runup and probabilistic margins. A strong main barrier cannot compensate for a distant low crest, and settlement may continue. Coarse map contours can hide bypass routes that require detailed joint and crossing surveys. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Continuous defence elevations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「防線接續高程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Continuous defence elevations”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 防線接續高程

knowledge.textEn: Barrier and bank defences must form a continuous elevation line. Local low points bypass strong main structures, making datum consistency, settlement and sill elevation more important than average wall height.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「防線接續高程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Continuous defence elevations" is correct?
options: 主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。

steps.title: 防線接續高程：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「防線接續高程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Remaining geometric freeboard is 0.58 m, excluding wave runup and probabilistic margins. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m. Remaining geometric freeboard is 0.58 m, excluding wave runup and probabilistic margins.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「防線接續高程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

quiz.explanationEn: Check pulse shape with sufficiently sampled pressure and acceleration records, examining whether filtering removes brief peaks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 波浪脈衝與反力：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 低取樣率可能完全漏掉撞擊峰值，過度放大峰值而忽略面積與相位也會誤判總力。氣泡含量及局部接觸使相鄰壓力計不一定同步到峰。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low sampling may miss impact peaks, while multiplying one peak over the entire area misstates total force. Air content and local contact mean adjacent sensors need not peak simultaneously. One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「檢測覆蓋與可用度」與「海平面情境與調適」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Test coverage and availability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 定期測試只能發現被測功能的故障，無法保證未施加的環境與荷載。檢測間隔與潛伏失效機率相關，但獨立恆定失效率只是基礎模型。 假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003；限λT很小及完美檢測。 若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。維修造成的暫時停用也屬可用度問題，不能因主設備故障率低就忽略。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「檢測覆蓋與可用度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
